Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About Triple Milk Deep Hydrating Body Wash for Women Can I use this product everyday? Yes, we recommend using this body wash for all skin types once a day, every day. Is this suitable for my skin type? Yes - this body wash can be used by all skin types, especially dry skin types. How much time will it take to see results? We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition, however you should start noticing a change within 3 months. Can I use this product on my face? This product is formulated for use on the body and may be too potent for the delicate skin on your face. We recommend using products specifically designed for facial moisturisation. What are the benefits of this body wash? This body wash deeply hydrates, soothes, and softens dry skin with its Triple Milk blend and moisture-infused beads - leaving your skin nourished, supple, and comfortable long after you shower.
